item.title: Maine’s most expensive old house listing! Harbor Watch, Circa 1900. $9,998,000
item.description: Welcome to Maine’s most expensive old house listing! Known as Harbor Watch. It was built in 1900. It is located on 2.2 acres in Kennebunkport, Maine. The property has beautiful grounds with landscaped gardens and a pretty in-ground pool. There are views of Kennebunk River and the Atlantic Ocean beyond. There is a large custom bar and pretty areas for entertaining. Five bedrooms, nine bathrooms and 12,612 square feet. $9,998,000 From the Zillow listing: Welcome to Harbor Watch-a distinguished est

item.title: Cute log cabin! Almost two acres in Maryland. $285,000
item.description: This is a cute log cabin. Could use some undoing of past renovations, but this has a lot of potential. The house was built in 1953. It is located on 1.86 acres in Smithsburg, Maryland. The cabin features a covered front porch, wood floors, brick fireplace and some knotty pine. item.description: Take a look inside this building in Massachusetts. Sure wasn’t expecting that! The building was constructed in 1850. It is located in Pittsfield, Massachusetts. The building features wood floors, tall ceilings, exposed brick, bead board ceilings, updated kitchen and updated bathrooms. There is a nice backyard patio area. item.title: Talk Amongst Yourselves! On 217 acres in Virginia. $800,000
item.description: Talk amongst yourselves! I had high hopes for this listing! The red of the house, the setting, the acreage, I got excited to look inside. The first few interior pictures had me excited…..then I started looking closer. I understand the price is about the acreage, but geeze, that acreage sure is having to do a lot of the heavy lifting. item.description: This house has a pretty setting! There is a large creek and multiple outbuildings! The house was built in 1898. It is located on five acres in Seminary, Mississippi. I would undo some of the DIY stuff, but the house could easily be worked room by room! item.description: This antebellum cottage has a lot of potential! There are nice tall ceilings inside. The cottage was built in 1860. It is located in Vicksburg, Mississippi. The house features a covered front porch, tall ceilings, wood floors, chair rails, crown moulding, ceiling medallion and a pretty chandelier. Within walking distance to downtown restaurants and shopping. item.title: Pretty woodwork! Great kitchen sink! Circa 1890 in New York. $300,000
item.description: This house has really pretty woodwork! Love the staircase! I want the kitchen sink! The house was built in 1890. It is located in Rochester, New York. The house features a large covered front porch, pretty staircase with built-in seating, original wood floors, baseboards, built-in bookshelves, spacious rooms, pocket doors, great kitchen sink and a second staircase. There is a large basement. Six bedrooms, three bathrooms and 3,726 square feet. $300,000 Contact Dayna Orione-Kim with Keller Willia
